name: She Only Visits At Night
source:
A short, atmospheric slice-of-life narrative inspired by SCP-134.

You play as a lonely night clerk whose quiet routine is slowly transformed by a strange girl who only visits after the sun goes down. She is never frightening, only unusual—quiet, distant, and always looking upward as if she can still see the sky through the fluorescent ceiling. 

[Edited from [url=https://neuroticfly.itch.io/she-only-visits-at-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部受SCP-134启发的短篇氛围系日常叙事作品。

你将扮演一名孤独的夜班店员，平静如水的日常因一位只在日落后造访的奇异少女而悄然改变。她从不令人感到恐惧，只是有些与众不同——安静、疏离，总是仰望着上方，仿佛透过日光灯管交错的天花板依旧能望见夜空。

[摘自[url=https://neuroticfly.itch.io/she-only-visits-at-night]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
